import numpy as np, json
def solve(I):
    A=np.array(I); H,W=A.shape
    # find frames: contiguous lines forming rectangles of single color > 1 thick borders; treat any color forming a full rectangle outline
    out=A.copy()
    colors=[v for v in sorted(set(A[A!=0].tolist()))]
    # identify frames: colors whose cells span a rectangle outline (top/bottom rows full, left/right cols full)
    def is_frame(v):
        pts=set(zip(*np.where(A==v)))
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        return min(rs)==max(rs)-A[max(rs],min(rs)] or True
    frames=[]
    noise_colors=[]
    for v in colors:
        pts=list(zip(*np.where(A==v)))
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        # outline complete?
        ok=(all(A[r0,c]==v for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(A[r1,c]==v for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(A[r,c0]==v for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and all(A[r,c1]==v for r in range(r0,r1+1)))
        area=(r1-r0)*(c1-c0)
        frames.append((ok,v,r0,r1,c0,c1,len(pts)))
    framed=[f for f in frames if f[0]]
    nc=[f for f in frames if not f[0]]
    print(framed, nc)
    # assign fills by size ranking
    framed.sort(key=lambda f:f['area'])
    nc.sort(key=lambda f:f[-1])  # by count
    fillmap={}
    for i,(f) in enumerate(framed):
        vc=f['v']
        fillmap[vc]=nc[i%len(nc)]['v']
    print(fillmap)
    for f in framed:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=f['r0'],f['r1'],f['c0'],f['c1']
        fc=fillmap[f['v']]
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if A[r,c]==0 and (r+c)%2==0:
                    out[r,c]=fc
    return out.tolist()
